metadata.title: GEEK Protocol — Kaspa 500 milestone expansion
metadata.schema: correctIndex is zero-based; options contains four distinct strings
metadata.reviewNotice: Original distinct questions internally checked against pinned implementation evidence. Implementation details describe the cited snapshot, not activation or support on every current network. Difficulty is provisional, not independently calibrated.
metadata.attribution: GEEK Protocol original questions. Kaspanet Rusty Kaspa source is credited per item as primary implementation evidence; no source prose or code is imported.

questions.prompt: What does the pay_address in a Kaspa block-template request tell the node?
options: Where the mining reward should be paid
Which peer should validate the block
Which exchange sets the KAS price
Where to upload the wallet seed

questions.attribution: GEEK Protocol original question; Kaspanet Rusty Kaspa source provides implementation evidence.

Replace its rewards with token balances

Its block may not be accepted by the network

Have the same DAA score, regardless of reachability
